fields.description: Role label from TITLE-ONLY rules (config/roles.json + overrides in config/dataset_build.json)
fields.name: role

fields.description: core | conditional_limited (core role failing a dataset target or forced conditional by policy) | conditional | adjacent_not_core
fields.name: role_status

fields.description: Core: role name; conditional security families: 'Security (conditional family)'; UX/Financial Analyst: own name
fields.name: role_group

fields.description: canonical = first (canonical) title pattern matched; synonym = another documented variant
fields.name: mapping_tier

fields.description: Lowercase alphanumeric normalisation used for grouping
fields.name: employer_normalized

fields.description: Second element of location_area, when present
fields.name: location_region

fields.description: location_area has at least two levels
fields.name: location_has_region

fields.description: raw category.label (Adzuna's own category; not a domain label)
fields.name: category_label

fields.description: raw salary_min; currency and period are NOT provided by the API (interpretation unresolved)
fields.name: salary_min

fields.description: JSON list: adzuna_predicted, min_gt_max, non_positive, below_floor, above_ceiling (invalid); point_value, one_sided (informational)
fields.name: salary_flags

fields.description: Present, not Adzuna-predicted, min <= max, and within a numeric range of 100,000 to 10,000,000. This is a NUMERIC SCREEN ONLY: the API provides no currency or pay-period field and the period interpretation is UNRESOLVED
fields.name: salary_passes_plausibility_screen

fields.description: Raw file the kept record came from
fields.name: source_file

fields.description: Query text (title_only variant for runs; category name from filename for legacy, confirmed by pull log)
fields.name: source_query

fields.description: Config role that requested the posting. NOT the role label
fields.name: source_query_role

fields.description: Page fetch time (runs only; null for legacy)
fields.name: collection_timestamp

fields.description: JSON list of every query role that retrieved this posting (after dedup merge)
fields.name: query_roles_seen

fields.description: JSON list of other 'run|query' sources that returned the same or a near-duplicate posting
fields.name: also_seen_in

fields.description: Number of raw records with this job id
fields.name: id_dup_count

fields.description: Number of identical-snippet duplicates merged into this posting (1 = none)
fields.name: near_dup_group_size

fields.description: Candidate-group hash of normalized title + employer + first 150 description chars (null if any part missing); merging additionally required an identical full snippet
fields.name: near_dup_key

fields.description: core rows: retained | excluded_by_5pct_cap; other partitions: not_applicable. Rows excluded by the cap stay in the full validated dataset
fields.name: employer_cap_status

fields.description: True for core-role rows retained by the employer cap (membership of the final core analysis dataset)
fields.name: in_core_analysis_dataset

fields.description: description_raw ends with the ellipsis character
fields.name: description_is_truncated

fields.description: non_english_suspected if >30% of alphabetic characters in title+description are non-ASCII (flag only)
fields.name: language_flag

origin_legend.PROVENANCE: collection metadata (or file-name derived for the legacy pull)
origin_legend.SOURCE: copied unchanged from the Adzuna raw record

rules: role is TITLE-BASED; never use title, role, source_query_role or mapping_tier as predictive features
no text normalisation, tokenisation, embeddings or skill vectors are stored
salary period and currency are unresolved
